## WorkerThreadErrorHandler.setDefault() method

Set the package-wide error handler used when no per-instance `error` listeners are attached.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static setDefault(handler: ((err: unknown) => void) | undefined): void;
```

## Example


